item.title: How Do HashMaps Work Under the Hood? (putting together a toy implementation in Rust to understand performance optimization, collisions, and time complexities)
item.description: HashMaps are incredibly convenient, but treating them like a magical black box can make it easy to overlook where their performance comes from. In this article, I explain how HashMaps work using a simple implementation in Rust. (1 source: rprogramming)
